decision.rationale: Three blocking exact-head defects allow caller-authored external PASS evidence, allow DEPLOYED without the required migration/backup/smoke/restore projections, and leave pg_restore disconnected from the declared isolated target. GitHub checks are green, but their current tests do not exercise these adversarial paths.

summary: PR #7 adds a pinned production candidate, hardened single-host topology, deployment evidence contracts and backup/restore operations. The repository candidate and exact-head CI are healthy, but the external trust boundary is not yet enforceable: a hand-written observation file becomes external PASS, the attempt journal accepts DEPLOYED with all substantive evidence null, and the restore process can target a loopback database unrelated to its declared isolated identity.

findings.title: External smoke PASS is minted from caller assertions
findings.observation: The smoke CLI reads a caller-owned JSON file, checks only that all assertion IDs are present, copies every claimed observation, and unconditionally sets status to PASS. It never calls the added HTTP, TLS/header, network or synthetic-journey observers. The contract parser also accepts trusted=true without requiring the certificate hostname to equal the origin or the certificate interval to contain observedAt.
findings.trigger: Run deploy:lp05:smoke with all required IDs marked PASS, arbitrary 64-hex values and a certificate object that is expired or belongs to another hostname.
findings.impact: The command emits a canonical EXTERNAL_INITIAL/EXTERNAL_POST_RESTORE PASS without contacting the authorized domain or executing the story. That forged record can participate in the final equality chain, defeating AC 4-6 and 14-16 and allowing false production acceptance evidence.

evidence.description: Reviewer supplied origin demo.example.com, certificate hostname wrong.example.net with notAfter 2020-01-01, and 22 CALLER_ASSERTED PASS rows. The exact-head CLI emitted status PASS and smokeSha256 4540f85cb049779da964d52d1f9e0e722f3834a109f82afecc083b5b8d032588.
The CLI only loads JSON and calls buildSmokeEvidence; buildSmokeEvidence sets status PASS after an ID-set check.
The external certificate validator checks shapes and trusted=true but not origin hostname equality or validity at observedAt.
The approved plan requires the smoke engine to observe trusted HTTPS, exact target/candidate/story facts and reject hand-written PASS.

findings.remediation: Make the production smoke command actively collect every assertion from the exact authorized origin and live runtime, validate certificate hostname and validity against observedAt, run the LP-04 journey, derive digests from observed responses, and keep any observation-import mode permanently LOCAL/TEST_FIXTURE. Add the forged/expired/wrong-host counterexample to the exact-head gate.
findings.verification: A caller-authored external PASS, wrong-host certificate, expired/not-yet-valid certificate, skipped HTTP assertion, fabricated story digest and local/fixture observation must all fail; a controlled real HTTPS rehearsal must pass only from engine-derived evidence.

findings.title: Attempt journal accepts DEPLOYED without required evidence
findings.observation: State projection validates only the transition hash chain and that sourceDatabase is non-null after safety resolution. It does not parse the database identity or require/verify the state-specific migration, smoke, backup, restore, production-unchanged and rollback projections. Controller oracles return only an arbitrary digest plus an unrestricted projection; the controller then appends DEPLOYED without running cross-record equality. There is also no deploy:lp05 or rollback entrypoint and no production call site for runDeployment.
findings.trigger: Append the legal state names with digest-shaped evidence, set sourceDatabase to an empty object at SAFETY_BACKUP_RESOLVED, and leave migration, initialSmoke, postDeployBackup, restoreEvidence and postRestoreSmoke null.
findings.impact: The exact-head record verifier accepts currentState=DEPLOYED and a valid attempt digest despite having none of the facts required by AC 10-16. Oracle failure handling also only marks FAILED; it does not disable ingress or invoke rollback. The approved deployment/rollback/resume contract therefore cannot safely authorize or operate a real release.

evidence.description: Reviewer advanced a valid attempt through all legal transitions with sourceDatabase={} and all substantive projections null; finalizeAttemptRecord returned DEPLOYED successfully.
projectAttemptState requires only a non-null database marker and finishedAt parity; transitionAttempt merges any projection.
runDeployment trusts oracle digests/projections, appends DEPLOYED directly, and its catch path neither disables ingress nor calls rollbackApplication.
The 31 LP-05 unit tests never call runDeployment or final evidence verification; package.json omits the planned deploy:lp05 and deploy:lp05:rollback commands.
The approved plan requires state-specific equality revalidation, single-use locking, bounded resume, rollback and hand-written-PASS negatives before DEPLOYED.

findings.remediation: Implement the planned executable deployment and rollback commands. Validate each oracle's closed evidence and exact envelope/candidate/target/source-DB relationships before its transition; make state projections required by state; run the final cross-record/evidence verifier before DEPLOYED; enforce the single-target/single-attempt lock, bounded resume and ingress-disable/rollback failure path. Add full fresh/upgrade/fault-injection tests and a negative equivalent to the reviewer reproduction.
findings.verification: Missing, null, local, stale, wrong-target or wrong-candidate evidence must fail at the first affected transition; no failure may append DEPLOYED; the executable controller must demonstrate fresh/upgrade success, every boundary failure, one bounded resume, authorization reuse rejection and rollback/ingress behavior.

findings.title: pg_restore destination is not bound to the isolated target
findings.observation: The mutation-time guard compares caller-provided isolatedTarget and productionIdentity objects, then only requires PGHOST to be localhost/127.0.0.1. PGPORT and PGDATABASE are independently supplied environment values; they are not checked against isolatedTarget.origin/databaseName, and the target object is not fully parsed before pg_restore. The CLI can therefore declare a safe generated restore target while restoring to a different loopback database.
findings.trigger: Supply a request containing distinct-looking isolatedTarget metadata but set PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE to any other loopback PostgreSQL database, including a production instance exposed on loopback.
findings.impact: pg_restore writes to the environment-selected database and can modify the wrong instance. This violates the hard AC 10/12 boundary that isolated recovery must never connect to or overwrite production and makes the recovery command unsafe to authorize.

evidence.description: restore-cli takes destination connection fields exclusively from process environment while isolatedTarget comes from an unrelated request object.
restoreEncryptedBackup checks only PGHOST loopback, then passes PGDATABASE directly to pg_restore.
The isolated-recovery unit test checks only metadata inequality and never exercises restoreEncryptedBackup or destination binding.
The approved plan requires the generated project/database, loopback origin, container, volume and system identities to be exact before any restore mutation.

findings.remediation: Generate the restore environment from one validated isolated-target record or verify exact host, port, database name, compose project/container/volume labels and live system identifier immediately before spawning pg_restore. Reject any mismatch with the production identity and require the database name suffix/unique target contract at mutation time.
findings.verification: Add spawned-command tests showing a different PGDATABASE, PGPORT, origin, project, container, volume, system identifier, production identity or non-generated target all fail before age/pg_restore starts; an exact newly created labelled restore target passes.

required_actions.action: Replace caller-authored external smoke PASS with engine-observed HTTPS/network/story evidence and add forged certificate/assertion negatives.
Ship and test the executable stateful deployment/rollback controller with strict state evidence, equality, locking, resume and failure recovery before DEPLOYED.
Bind the actual pg_restore connection exactly to the validated generated isolated target before mutation.
